meta.title: A bid quantity below Min Quantity is refused

steps.note: Start a multi-stage event create flow.
Create an RFQ rather than the default auction stage.
Apply the RFQ pricing template before adding line items.
Add the line to which the minimum quantity rule applies.
Populate the RFQ pricing sheet so the event can be published.

args.goal: On the RFQ create screen, add or configure the Min Quantity column for the first line item and set its value to 10, leaving the RFQ create screen ready to publish

steps.note: Configure the minimum quantity, which has no dedicated catalog step.
Invite the vendor who will submit the below-minimum offer.
Confirm the RFQ reached its published project page.
Open the published RFQ bid sheet in the supplier portal.
Offer quantity 9, below the configured minimum quantity of 10.
Provide the required bid price so quantity validation is exercised.

args.because: Quantity should be greater than Q

steps.note: Submit the below-minimum offer and require Procol to refuse it with the quantity validation message.
